svg.text: ms: one Blackhole P150A, 1,920 x 1,080, the median frame on the card at each scene's overview. gi less push: the stage-wise frame less its push
to the host. Pictures: gi_threads in the viewer at 1,024 x 1,024. Build: on the host, 8 tracer threads (dense + SVD: 16 CPUs).
Bytes: the planes written between the stage-wise steps against the display rows. Lists: a look down 40 degrees, grown against a reload.
Scenes: Crytek Sponza (Frank Meinl, Crytek; CC BY 3.0); Amazon Lumberyard Bistro (ORCA; CC BY 4.0); Breakfast Room, The Modern Living Room (Wig42; CC BY 3.0).
